0901: Loop the band around your ankles or anchor it low.

Squeeze your glute at the top.
0902: Secure the band over your shoulders and under your feet or anchor.

Rise until your torso is in line with your legs.
0903: Stand on the band, hinge forward and hold the ends.

0905: Anchor the band high and kneel facing it.
Grab the ends with arms extended up.
Pull your elbows down toward your ribs.
0906: Get on all fours with the band around one foot and in your hands.
Kick the banded leg back and up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
0907: Stand on the band and hold the ends at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to shoulder height.
0908: Anchor the band low and stand with a staggered stance.
Hold the ends with arms slightly bent.
Sweep your arms up and together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
0909: Stand on the band with the ends held at your shoulders.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to return.
0910: Lie on your back with the band set around your feet or anchored.
Lift your legs toward the ceiling.
Curl your hips off the floor.
0911: Lie face down with a band anchored to your ankles.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
0912: Lie on your back with the band around your legs.
Raise one leg against the band.
0913: Anchor the band at chest height and stand facing away.
Hold the ends with slightly bent elbows.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest.
0915: Loop the band across your upper back, holding the ends under your palms.
Set up in a high plank.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up against the band.
Keep your body in a straight line.
0917: Stand on the band and hold the ends with palms down.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders.
0919: Stand on the band on one leg and hold the ends.
Keep a slight bend in the standing knee.
Hinge forward with a flat back and kick the free leg back.
Return by driving your hips forward.
0921: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the end with your elbow bent at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm outward away from your body.
0923: Anchor the band low behind you and hold the ends at your chest.
Press your hands up and forward.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
0924: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the end with your elbow bent at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm across toward your belly.
0926: Anchor the band behind you and loop it around one ankle.
Hold support and lift the knee slightly.
Bend slowly to return, then switch legs.
0927: Loop the band around your ankle and anchor it behind you.
0928: Anchor the band overhead and stand facing it.
Hold the ends with straight arms.
Pull your hands down toward your thighs.
0930: Anchor the band at chest height and hold the ends.
Pull your elbows back past your ribs.
0931: Anchor the band low and hold it with both hands beside the anchor.
Rotate your torso, pulling the band diagonally up.
0934: Stand on the middle of the band with feet hip-width apart and grip the ends with both hands.
Let your arms hang in front of your thighs with the band slightly taut.
Pull your hands up along your body, leading with the elbows, until they reach about chest height.
Pause briefly, then lower under control without letting the band snap back.
Keep your chest tall and your shoulders away from your ears.
0935: Anchor a band at elbow height and stand sideways to it, holding the handle with the far hand.
Tuck your elbow against your side with the elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm away from your belly, keeping the elbow pinned in place.
Pause when your hand points slightly outward, then return slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
0938: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles lightly for balance.
Push one pedal down while the other rises, keeping a smooth rhythm.
Stand tall and keep your knees pointing forward.
Continue at a comfortable pace for several minutes, adjusting resistance as needed.
Slow down gradually before stepping off.
0942: Start on all fours with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Exhale and press the floor away as you round your back toward the ceiling.
Tuck your chin toward your chest and draw your belly in.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Inhale and return to a neutral back.
0943: Stand with feet together and arms at your sides.
Bend your knees and sit your hips back and down as if lowering into a chair.
Reach your arms up beside your ears and lengthen your spine.
Sink a little deeper while keeping your weight in your heels.
Hold for 5 slow breaths, then straighten your legs to stand.
0944: Stand with feet together or hip-width apart.
Bend your knees and send your hips back, keeping your chest lifted.
Raise your arms overhead with palms facing each other.
Keep your knees over your ankles and your tailbone tucked slightly.
Hold for 5 slow breaths, then stand up.
0945: Kneel on the floor with big toes touching and knees apart.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Fold forward and slide your arms out in front of you.
Rest your forehead on the floor and relax your shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
0946: Squat with feet together and place your hands flat on the floor shoulder-width apart.
Bend your elbows slightly and rest your shins against the backs of your upper arms.
Shift your weight forward onto your hands and lift one foot, then the other.
Round your upper back, draw your belly in and gaze slightly ahead.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower your feet gently.
0947: Stand tall with feet together and raise your arms overhead, palms joined.
Reach up through your fingertips and keep your hips level.
Lean your upper body slowly to one side in a gentle curve.
Hold for 3 to 5 breaths without twisting forward or back.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.
0948: Stand with feet about hip-width apart and weight even on both feet.
Let your arms hang naturally at your sides.
Lengthen your spine and gently draw your ribs down.
Relax your shoulders and look straight ahead.
Breathe calmly for a few breaths.
0949: Start on hands and knees with hands slightly ahead of shoulders.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back.
Straighten your legs as far as comfortable and press your chest toward your thighs.
Spread your fingers and push the floor away.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
0950: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms at your sides, palms down.
Press your forearms into the floor and lift your chest.
Arch your upper back and lower the crown of your head lightly toward the floor.
Keep your legs relaxed and breathe deeply into the chest.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lower slowly.
0951: Stand with feet slightly wider than hips and toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat, keeping your heels down if you can.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Press your elbows against your inner knees and lengthen your spine.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
0952: Start in a wide-legged stance and turn one foot out.
Bend over that leg and place your hand on the floor or a block ahead of the foot.
Lift the back leg until it is parallel to the floor.
Open your chest and stack your hips, reaching the top arm up.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower and switch sides.
0953: Hinge at the hips and fold forward with a long spine.
Slide your hands under your feet with palms up, toes on your fingers.
Pull gently to deepen the stretch while keeping your knees slightly soft.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
0954: Kneel with knees together and feet slightly wider than your hips.
Sit your hips down between your heels, using a block if needed.
Rest your hands on your thighs and lengthen your spine.
Relax your shoulders and breathe evenly.
Hold for 30-60 seconds, then come out slowly.
0955: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Lift one leg and let it open out to the side, keeping the other leg down.
Keep your hips squared and your lower back relaxed.
Hold the stretch gently, breathing steadily.
Return to the middle and repeat with the other leg.
0956: Sit tall with legs stretched out in front of you.
Bend one knee and place that foot high on the opposite thigh.
Bend the other knee and place that foot on top, if your hips allow it.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.
Breathe slowly for 30-60 seconds, then switch which leg goes on top.
0957: Step into a long lunge with the back heel lifted.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist your torso and hook the opposite elbow outside the front knee.
Press your palms together and look up or ahead.
Hold for 3 to 5 breaths, then switch sides.
0958: Sit on the floor with legs spread as wide as is comfortable.
Flex your feet and keep your knees pointing up.
Walk your hands forward and fold from the hips.
Keep your spine long instead of rounding.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
0959: Hinge at your hips and fold forward, keeping your knees slightly soft.
Let your hands rest on the floor or hold opposite elbows.
Relax your neck and let the weight of your head drop.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
0960: Stand with feet wide apart and toes pointing forward.
Hinge forward at the hips with a long spine.
Lower your hands to the floor or your shins.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
0961: Stand tall and shift your weight onto one foot.
Place the sole of the other foot on your inner calf or thigh, never on the knee.
Bring your palms together at your chest or raise them overhead.
Fix your eyes on one point to stay steady.
Hold for 5 breaths, then switch legs.
0962: Stand with feet wide apart and turn one foot out 90 degrees.
Raise your arms to shoulder height.
Reach toward the front foot, then lower that hand to your shin or the floor.
Extend the other arm up and look toward it.
Hold for 3 to 5 breaths, then switch sides.
0963: Stand with feet wide and turn your front foot out.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Turn your head to look over the front hand.
Hold for 5 breaths, then switch sides.
0964: Step one foot back into a long stance, with the back foot turned out slightly.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Square your hips toward the front.
Raise both arms overhead and lift your chest.
Hold for 5 breaths, then switch sides.
0965: Stand with feet about one leg-length apart and toes pointing slightly in.
Place your hands on your hips and hinge forward with a flat back.
Lower your hands to the floor under your shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
0966: Stand with feet hip width apart, bar over mid-foot.
Hinge at the hips and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Lock out your hips at the top without leaning back.
Lower the bar by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
0967: Stand with feet hip width apart, bar over mid-foot.
Hinge at the hips and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Lock out your hips at the top without leaning back.
Lower the bar by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
0968: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and slowly curl one arm up towards your shoulder, squeezing your biceps at the top.
Lower the arm back down to the starting position and repeat with the other arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
0969: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight and your arms extended overhead, holding the band.
Engage your abs and lift your legs and upper body off the ground simultaneously, reaching your hands towards your toes.
As you lower your legs and upper body back down, switch the position of your legs, crossing one over the other.
Repeat the movement, alternating the position of your legs with each repetition.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions.
0970: Attach the band to a pull-up bar or sturdy anchor point.
Step onto the band and grip the bar with your palms facing away from you, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms fully extended, keeping your core engaged and your shoulders down and back.
Pull your body up towards the bar by squeezing your shoulder blades together and driving your elbows down towards your hips.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar, then slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
0971: Kneel on the floor and hold the handles of the band with both hands, palms facing down.
Place the band on the ground in front of you and position your hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and slowly roll the wheel forward, extending your body as far as you can while maintaining control.
Pause for a moment at the furthest point, then slowly roll the wheel back towards your knees to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
0972: Lie flat on your back with your hands behind your head and your knees bent.
Lift your feet off the ground and bring your right knee towards your chest while simultaneously twisting your torso to bring your left elbow towards your right knee.
Straighten your right leg while bringing your left knee towards your chest and twisting your torso to bring your right elbow towards your left knee.
Continue alternating the twisting motion, as if you are pedaling a bicycle, while keeping your core engaged throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
0973: Sit or stand with the band looped under the balls of your feet.
Hold the ends firmly so the band is taut.
Press up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Keep your ankles straight and avoid rolling out.
0974: Attach the band to a high anchor point, such as a pull-up bar or sturdy beam.
Stand facing the anchor point and grab the band with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Step back to create tension in the band, keeping your feet hip-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your back straight as you pull the band down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the band back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
0975: Place a band around your upper arms, just above the elbows.
Assume a push-up position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
0976: Sit on a bench or chair with your legs spread apart and your feet flat on the ground.
Hold one end of the band in your hand and step on the other end with your foot on the same side.
Lean forward slightly and rest your elbow on the inside of your thigh, just above the knee.
With your palm facing up, slowly curl your hand towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hand back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
0977: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band in front of your thighs with your palms facing down.
Keep your arms straight and lift the band up in front of you until your arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the band back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
0978: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band in front of your thighs with your palms facing down.
Keep your arms straight and slowly raise them forward until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
0979: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point at waist height.
Stand perpendicular to the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the band handle with both hands and step away from the anchor point to create tension in the band.
Bring your hands to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Engage your core and maintain a stable stance.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, pushing the band away from your body.
Hold the extended position for a few seconds, focusing on maintaining tension in your core.
Slowly bring your hands back to your chest, resisting the pull of the band.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
0980: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point at ankle height.
Stand facing away from the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step back to create tension in the band, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Hinge at the hips and lean forward, maintaining a neutral spine.
Extend your right leg straight back, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Lower your right leg back down and repeat with the left leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
0981: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight and your arms extended overhead, holding the band.
Engage your abs and lift your legs and upper body simultaneously, bringing your hands towards your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs and upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
0982: Lie on your side with knees bent and a loop band around your thighs just above the knees.
Keep your feet together and your hips stacked.
Rotate the top knee upward, opening like a clamshell.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides.
Keep your pelvis still so the movement comes from the hip.
0983: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point above your head.
Kneel down and hold the band with one hand, palm facing down.
Extend your arm fully overhead, keeping your elbow slightly bent.
Engage your lat muscles and pull the band down towards your side, bringing your elbow towards your ribcage.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
0984: Lie on your back with your legs straight and a resistance band looped around your feet.
Bend your knees and bring them towards your chest, keeping your feet together.
Slowly rotate your knees outwards, away from each other, while keeping your feet together.
Pause for a moment at the end of the rotation, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
0985: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point at waist height.
Kneel down facing away from the anchor point and hold the band with both hands, keeping your elbows bent and close to your sides.
Engage your abs and slowly twist your torso to one side, bringing your hands towards your opposite hip.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
0986: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place one end of the band under your foot.
Hold the other end of the band with your arm fully extended overhead, palm facing forward.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, curl your forearm towards your shoulder, squeezing your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your forearm back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
0987: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place a resistance band around your ankles.
Extend one leg forward and rest the top of your foot on a bench or step behind you.
Hold onto a support with one hand for balance.
Bend your standing leg and lower your body down into a squat position, keeping your knee in line with your toes.
Push through your heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
0988: Attach the band to a stable anchor point at waist height.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band with one hand, palm facing inward, and step back to create tension in the band.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Pull the band towards your waist, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release the band back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
0989: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point at chest height.
Stand with your side facing the anchor point and grab the band with one hand.
Step away from the anchor point to create tension in the band.
Position your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly bend your knees.
Bring your hand holding the band across your body, towards the opposite shoulder.
While maintaining tension in the band, push your hand forward and away from your body, extending your arm.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Switch sides and repeat the exercise with the other hand.
0990: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold the band with one hand and extend your arm fully in front of you.
Keeping your back straight, pull the band towards your body by bending your elbow and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
At the same time, twist your torso towards the side of the pulling arm.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly release the tension in the band and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
0991: Attach a resistance band to a sturdy anchor point at ground level.
Stand facing away from the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step forward to create tension in the band, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Hinge at the hips and push your glutes back, maintaining a slight bend in your knees.
Lower your torso until it is parallel to the ground, feeling a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
0992: Attach the band securely to a stable anchor point.
Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the band with both hands and extend your arms straight up towards the ceiling.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
0993: Attach the band to a stationary object at chest height.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band with both hands in front of you.
Keep your arms straight and lift them out to the sides until they are parallel to the ground.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
0994: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground.
Hold the band with an overhand grip, palms facing down, and wrap it around your fingers.
Rest your forearms on your thighs, with your wrists hanging off the edge.
Slowly curl your wrists upward, squeezing your forearms.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your wrists back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
0995: Sit on a bench or chair with a band looped around your knees or thighs.
Keep your feet planted and your back tall.
Push your knees apart against the band.
Hold briefly at the widest point.
Bring your knees back together slowly.
Keep your torso still and avoid leaning.
0996: Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Place a resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Keep your knees bent at a 90-degree angle and your feet shoulder-width apart.
Engage your glutes and slowly rotate your knees outward, pushing against the resistance of the band.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
0997: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band under your feet.
Hold the band with your palms facing forward and raise your hands to shoulder height, elbows bent.
Press the band overhead, fully extending your arms.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the band back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
0998: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band with both hands, palms facing down.
Extend your arms straight out to the sides, keeping them parallel to the ground.
Slowly bend your elbows and bring your hands towards your shoulders, keeping your upper arms still.
Pause for a moment, then slowly extend your arms back out to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
0999: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place the band around the ball of your left foot.
Hold onto a stable object for balance if needed.
Slowly raise your left heel off the ground, lifting your body weight onto the ball of your foot.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your left heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the right leg.
